# Alchetron

> > A free social encyclopedia covering 5M+ topics across history, entertainment, technology, sports, and culture with collaborative knowledge sharing.

Alchetron is a comprehensive online encyclopedia platform that enables users to explore, contribute, and share knowledge across diverse subjects ranging from military history and cricket to programming concepts and entertainment. The platform emphasizes social collaboration and information organization with extensive biographical and historical content.

## Key Topics

- Social encyclopedia
- Knowledge sharing
- Biography
- Military history
- Imperial Japanese Army
- English cricket history
- Entertainment & media
- Technology & programming
- Music history
- Sports history
- Cultural topics
- Information organization
- Content collaboration
- Historical events
- Platform overview

## Platform Overview

- [Alchetron, Free Social Encyclopedia for The World](https://alchetron.com): Homepage for Alchetron social encyclopedia with 5M+ topics
- [Alchetron, The Free Social Encyclopedia for Everyone](https://alchetron.com/welcome): Welcome page explaining Alchetron's social encyclopedia platform
- [About Alchetron](https://alchetron.com/aboutUs): Company mission and platform features for Alchetron encyclopedia
- [Encyclopedia](https://alchetron.com/Encyclopedia): Encyclopedia definition, history, and etymology from Pliny to Wikipedia
- [Alchetron - Contact Information](https://alchetron.com/contact): Contact info for queries and career opportunities at Alchetron

## Military & Historical Topics

- [11th Independent Mixed Brigade (Imperial Japanese Army)](https://alchetron.com/11th-Independent-Mixed-Brigade-(Imperial-Japanese-Army)): Imperial Japanese Army brigade history covering WWII China operations
- [19th United States Congress](https://alchetron.com/19th-United-States-Congress): 1825-1827 Congress under John Quincy Adams, Erie Canal completion
- [Cat o' nine tails](https://alchetron.com/Cat-o'-nine-tails): Royal Navy multi-tailed whip used for corporal punishment history
- [1965 Official Guide New York World's Fair](https://alchetron.com/1965-Official-Guide-New-York-World's-Fair): Time-Life Books guide to 1964/65 World's Fair exhibits & pavilions

- [13: Fear Is Real](https://alchetron.com/13:-Fear-Is-Real): 2009 CW horror reality TV elimination competition series
- [1 vs. 100](https://alchetron.com/1-vs.-100): Endemol game show format with international variants & rules

## Music & Arts

- [1979–80 League Cup (rugby league)](https://alchetron.com/1979–80-League-Cup-(rugby-league)): John Player Trophy rugby league knockout won by Bradford Northern
